item.title: Agents @ Home
item.description: Since the first time anyone said “coding agents,” I’ve basically only wanted one thing: an intern I can assign tasks to, whenever they pop into my mind, and expect results eventually. Claude Code and OpenAI Codex are getting there, in terms of the pure capability. But they’re also chew through tokens quickly, add huge markups (4-5x) on sandbox usage, and are not that easily customizable. For example, I’ve been working on a bit of a software benchmark, and I want to test different models on it, which requires a custom setup. I thought software engineering was solved, so can we do something here?
